value.answer: Tuesday in Toronto looks wet and warm. Showers early, then mainly cloudy with a 60% chance of showers and a risk of thunderstorms through the day. High of 24°C, 10 to 20 mm of rain possible, and gusty southwest wind up to 40 km/h around noon. Tuesday night drops to about 12°C.
